title: Escape Tactic
specs: Largest escape room in Charlotte with over 8,000 sq ft and 7 games
Rooms feature immersive themes with props like life sized King Tut sarcophagus and 8' waterfall
Guests 10 and up; under 10 must book private event
Adult over 18 required with players 14 and younger
No special skills or puzzle experience needed
People with heart conditions, anxiety, PTSD, light/sound sensitivity, pregnancy should consider risks
Rooms hold 2-10 players; can host up to 70 people per hour
Private games available for groups booking all slots or private event option
includes: Game Masters to guide and provide hints
Use of themed room and puzzles
gap: Exact maximum group size per room not stated beyond 10
blurb: Escape Tactic offers professionally designed escape rooms where players have 60 minutes to solve puzzles and escape. The rooms are themed and designed to challenge logic, teamwork, and communication. They are suitable for team building, corporate events, and group outings.
extraNote: Reservations recommended; can show up if space available · No refunds or credits for cancellations or changes within 48 hours of game time · No refunds for no-shows or missed game times · Large group bookings require one week notice for changes · No outside alcohol allowed; intoxicated patrons may be refused entry · Players must follow written and verbal instructions; no breaking or removing items · Players under influence of drugs or alcohol may be removed without refund · Cell phones not allowed in rooms; must be stored in lockers
